title: Elixir, The Amrut
lead: An Ayurvedic nutritional supplement for cows and calves: a galactogogue, an antioxidant, a health rejuvenator and an immunity enhancer.
heroAlt: Elixir, The Amrut: an Ayurvedic nutritional supplement for cows and calves, shown beside a cow, her calf and an Elixir pack.
quote: The healthy mother gives a healthy calf.

what.title: What is Elixir?
what.first: Elixir is a mineral mixture and feed supplement that cattle need for healthy growth and reproduction. A mother cow's nutrition is at the heart of a healthy herd.
what.second: It is made from pure Ayurvedic herbs and carries all the essential macro and micro minerals, with natural sources of vitamins, minerals, protein, prebiotics and probiotics.
what.imageAlt: Elixir poster: an Ayurvedic nutritional supplement, the best galactogogue and a health rejuvenator, with a cow and her calf in a meadow.

why.title: Why Elixir for your cows?
why.first: A complete mineral supplement can make a real difference to how your cattle perform. Minerals are only a small part of the diet, but they play a big role in a cow's overall health.
why.second: Small mineral gaps can easily go unnoticed, and show up later as lower fertility, slower growth and weaker immunity, all of which cut into your farm's returns. Feeding a complete mineral supplement all year round is simple, low-cost protection against these problems.
